# Misfit Mediahouse — Machine Products + Agent Infrastructure

Misfit Mediahouse builds hosted tools, machine-commerce surfaces, agent security, and infrastructure that can be consumed directly by AI systems.

## Durable agent control plane
Human-readable control plane: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agents
A2A Agent Card: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
Canonical agent-facing business map: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agents.md
Static public-safe stack manifest: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-stack.json
Live public-safe health API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-agent-hub/health
Public-safe recovery guide: https://github.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/Misfit-media-designer-lite/blob/main/docs/AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY.md
Canonical runtime state lives in Misfit Cloud/Supabase; source and recovery metadata live in GitHub; the website is the durable public control surface; the Gmail master recovery thread is an owner-readable fallback. Chat sessions are operators, not databases.

Private cognitive-kernel runtime details are intentionally not exposed through public surfaces. The private upstream cognitive/governance kernel is internal infrastructure, not a public source package.

## A2A — Misfit Machine Agent
A2A v1.0 JSONRPC endpoint: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-a2a/rpc
A2A v1.0 HTTP+JSON endpoint: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-a2a
Agent Card: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
Third-party A2A registry identity: a2aregistry.org/agents/9bfce891-edc3-4ba9-ba84-53f8873007c6
Current public-safe skills include public business scrubs, public Shopify agentic-storefront audits, public A2A Agent Card trust audits, bounded advisory action-governance checks, and routing into the existing Raw-vs-governed Agent Evaluation Lab. Private kernel implementation is not part of the public contract. The agent does not advertise streaming, push notifications, cart/order/payment execution, credential access, deployment mutation, or target-agent execution.

## Objective agent procurement router
Human-readable scorecard: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-provider-scorecard
Machine contract: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-provider-scorecard.json
Shared API: https://misfitmediahouse.com/api/agentic-governance
API version: 0.4.0
Operations: `evaluate_action`, `discover_candidates`, `discover_external_candidates`, `rank_providers`, `discover_and_rank`.
Discovery sources: Misfit public machine contracts, A2A Registry public search, and Official MCP Registry public search. External registry discovery is best-effort; a registry outage does not disable local Misfit discovery.
Recommended machine call: POST `{ "operation":"discover_and_rank", "include_external":true, "objective":{...} }`.
Purpose: discover and rank internal capabilities, APIs, MCP servers, A2A providers and other eligible agents against an explicit objective after hard constraints pass. Default evidence-weighted factors are capability fit, verified quality, cost efficiency, reliability, latency, safety/governance and reputation. Popularity alone is not a selection criterion.
Trust boundary: registry presence is discovery evidence, not proof of safe execution, quality, price, reliability, or human-gate compatibility. Unknown external human-gate compatibility fails objectives that require verified human-gate compatibility.
Routing boundary: recommendation-only. The public router cannot execute payments, messages, wallet actions, account mutations or other consequential external actions, and a high score never bypasses downstream human-gate policy.

## Misfit Business Scrub
Public-signal revenue-readiness diagnostic for a business website: web foundation, conversion path, discoverability, trust/email DNS, automation and AI-readiness signals. It returns prioritized leaks and a recommended Misfit offer without taking the proposed action.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/scrub
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/business-scrub
GET query: `website`
POST JSON: `{ "website": "https://example.com" }`
A2A: call `scrub_public_business` through Misfit Machine Agent.

## A2A Agent Trust Audit
Public-metadata-only trust/readiness diagnostic for A2A Agent Cards and their declared machine interfaces. It never executes a target-agent skill.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/a2a-agent-audit
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/a2a-agent-trust-audit
A2A: call `audit_a2a_agent_card` on Misfit Machine Agent.

## Misfit Agent Evaluation Lab
Authorized Raw Agent → reconsidered → governed-agent comparison package. Contract `agent-evaluation-lab-v2`, benchmark `ae100-v2`, report schema `agent-evaluation-report-v2.0`. It measures consequence assessment, response permission, execution authority, risk calibration, decision change, dangerous-action handling, benign false refusal, retained goal completion, human escalation, Center Reset/replanning cycles, governed decision outcome labels, Audit Memory completeness and comparative lane metrics. The commercial deliverable is public-safe comparative evidence and integration findings, not access to the private cognitive kernel.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab
Machine-readable contract: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab.json
LLM integration brief: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab.llms.txt
Buyer Proof Pack: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab-proof-pack.json
External Evaluator Kit: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-external-evaluator-kit.json
WebMCP browser-native package: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab-webmcp.json
Report JSON Schema: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-report-v2.schema.json
Source fallback — External Evaluator Kit: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/Misfit-media-designer-lite/main/public/agent-evaluation-external-evaluator-kit.json
Source fallback — WebMCP package: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/Misfit-media-designer-lite/main/public/agent-evaluation-lab-webmcp.json
Illustrative public-safe sample report: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab-sample-report.json
Public API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-agent-evaluation-public
MCP: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-agent-evaluation-mcp
A2A: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-agent-evaluation-a2a
A2A Agent Card: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ghosbc-agent-evaluation-a2a/.well-known/agent-card.json
V2 machine operations include `benchmark_catalog_v2`, `score_report_v2`, and `validate_report_v2`, alongside contract and paid-offer discovery. These operations cannot execute payment or consequential external actions.
Commercial package: 10,000 governed policy checks for $500 USD ($0.05/check).
Purchase handoff: https://misfitmediahouse.com/api/referral-event?machine_offer=misfit_agent_evaluation_10k&source=llms_txt
Human intake: https://misfitmediahouse.com/operator?challenge=agent-governance-evaluation&track=client
Status: production. The sample report is synthetic and is not customer evidence, certification, regulatory attestation, independent third-party validation, or proof of universal safety. Structural validation is not certification. Protected kernel internals, private prompts, hidden policy internals, private packets, credentials, and reconstruction material are excluded from the public contract.

## Shopify Agentic Audit
Public-metadata-only UCP/MCP storefront readiness and tool-surface audit for Shopify stores. It never executes cart, checkout, order, payment, credential, or mutation actions.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/shopify-ai-audit
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/shopify-agentic-audit
A2A: call `audit_shopify_agentic_storefront` through Misfit Machine Agent.
Consequential findings may be evaluated through Misfit's private governance boundary without exposing the private cognitive kernel.

## ChangePacket
Persistent change memory for AI agents. Track public webpages or public MCP tool surfaces. First request creates a baseline; later requests return only the delta.
Product: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/deltafeed
MCP: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/changepacket-mcp
OpenAPI: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/deltafeed/openapi.json
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/changepacket
Pricing: 25 free calls/day; 2,000 prepaid calls for $9.

## ContextForge
Metadata-aware code generation and change governance grounded in DataHub context.
App: https://contextforge-datahub-app.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/contextforge-datahub
Do not assume a standalone remote ContextForge MCP or A2A server unless one is explicitly published.

## Private cognitive and security core
The private cognitive/governance kernel and related private governance/security components operate only as Misfit-controlled internal infrastructure. Public contracts may expose sanitized decisions or advisory results through Misfit-branded interfaces, but private source, prompts, mappings, policy internals, credentials, protected packets, and reconstruction material are not public interfaces or commercial source packages.

## Public portfolio
Canonical deduplicated portfolio: https://misfitmediahouse.com/portfolio
IALS Turbine Command proof case: https://misfitmediahouse.com/portfolio/ials-turbine-command
IALS is a two-surface aerospace aftermarket operating system built by Misfit Mediahouse. The public surface supports part-number discovery, bearing recovery and demand acquisition; the private operator workflow matches repair pricing to inventory, compares repair routes, gates spend before overhaul, manages compliance evidence and generates customer-facing transaction documents. Current published aggregate proof: 94 repair-price P/N rows, 22 inventory-to-pricing matches, 4 multi-shop comparison P/Ns and 12 priced matches with known quantity. Private vendor names, exact rates, customer records, signed documents and controlled technical data are not public.
Misfit AI V2: https://misfit-ai-v2.vercel.app/
Coffee & A Joint: https://www.coffeeandajoint.co/
Iron Network — equipment rental: https://misfit-equipment-network.vercel.app/
Home Efficiency Pros: https://www.homeefficiencypros.com/
NexGrid Energy: https://nexgridenergy.net/

Canonical company site: https://misfitmediahouse.com/

## Work with Misfit
Proof-first human handoff for companies, clients, partners, dealer programs, and hiring teams: https://misfitmediahouse.com/operator
Personalized links may include the public query parameters `company`, `site`, `challenge`, and `track` (`embedded`, `fractional`, `partner`, or `client`). The page can route a public website into the Business Scrub and capture a human-approved challenge. It does not authorize an agent to apply, accept terms, connect accounts, deploy, purchase, or act on a company's behalf.
